subject: DR evidence & RTO/RPO artifacts for Clearwater Health - SIG follow-up
messages:
From: Megan Lee <megan.lee@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
Cc: compliance@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: DR artifacts + RTO/RPO numbers for SIG review

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Our security and third-party risk teams are wrapping up a SIG review and they have a few asks related to business continuity / disaster recovery before we can move forward with procurement: 

- RTO and RPO targets you commit to for the hosted inference endpoint (both warm-standby and cold-start scenarios)
- Copies of the failover / recovery runbook used in the most recent DR exercise
- Extracted traces or logs from the most recent recovery test (timestamps + elapsed times)
- Any attestation or certification file that speaks to recoverability (signed attestation is fine)

Can you provide these artifacts by EOD 2027-07-08? We prefer links (S3 or Drive) and a short manifest describing what each file contains. If you need a short call to confirm scope, happy to schedule.

Also: please redact any internal-only IP addresses or hostnames.

Appreciate it — Megan
Megan Lee
Sr. Manager, Third-Party Risk
Clearwater Health

Quick confirmations from our side:
- We can provide an artifacts bundle (S3 link) with a manifest and the specific files you listed.
- We will include a signed attestation that describes scope and redaction status.
- We typically present warm-standby RTOs (cache-warmed) and a separate cold-start RTO; we'll include percentile breakdowns (p50/p95).

Laura and Ben — looping you in to assemble the package and redact where needed. Ben, could you weigh in on whether the SIG team will need any additional SOC2 narrative excerpts?

Megan — would you like a 30-minute sync after you review the artifacts, or prefer we send everything first and then follow up?

Best,

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.inference, ben_carter@redwood.inference, rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:15:42 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: DR artifacts + RTO/RPO numbers for SIG review

Laura / Ben / Rishi — forwarding Megan's request. Target delivery: 2027-07-08. Please compile a package with the following minimal items: 

1) Signed attestation (PDF) that covers recoverability for the Redwood hosted inference service and notes any exclusions.
2) Recovery runbook PDF (redacted) — include steps for detection, failover, cache warming, validation, and rollback.
3) RTO/RPO matrix (CSV) — p50/p95 for warm-standby, cold-start full restore, and cross-region failover.
4) Restore traces (log snippet) for most recent tabletop/test exercise (include elapsed times and wall-clock timestamps).
5) Warm-cache timing samples (JSON) showing KV cache population times per model shard.
6) Short ops note describing any manual steps required for region failover and expected human-in-the-loop time.

Constraints / notes:
- Redact internal hostnames/IPs and any customer-identifying data.
- We should avoid including full log dumps; include curated extracts with timestamps.
- If the attestation needs an exec signature, Laura please advise who signs.

Rishi — do we have a canonical sample from the June 10 tabletop that we can reuse (redacted)? If so, attach it.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.inference>
To: jordan.blake@redwood.inference, ben_carter@redwood.inference, rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:20:06 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: DR artifacts + RTO/RPO numbers for SIG review

All — assembling package now. I redacted anything that looks like internal IPs and removed debug-only traces. Below is the manifest and an initial S3 link. I will upload the signed attestation later today (executive sig).

S3 package: https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/CLW-2027-06-25/package.zip (pre-signed link, expires 2027-07-09)

Manifest (included in package):
- dr-attestation-june2027.pdf — executive attestation covering recoverability scope and redaction notes (to be signed by Head of Ops).
- restore_runbook_v2.pdf — redacted runbook (sections: detection, automated failover, cache warm, validation checklist).
- rto-rpo-matrix.csv — series of committed targets and measured results from tabletop and live failovers.
- warm-cache-timings.json — sample KV cache warm times per shard (p50/p95).
- test-run-20270610.log — curated excerpt from the June 10 tabletop with elapsed times.

Key callouts (short):
- Warm-standby (cache-warmed) median RTO: 2m (120s); p95: 5m (300s). This reflects automated routing + KV cache restore.
- Cold-start RTO (full rebuild of model caches + state): median 25m; p95 45m.
- RPO: for control-plane metadata and routing we are typically <1s; for in-flight session state we recommend session persistence at the application layer — documented in runbook.
- Cross-region failover introduces additional DNS/infra propagation time (typically adds 2-6 minutes depending on customer DNS TTLs and upstream caches).

Attachments included in S3 (files above). All files have been scrubbed for internal-only hostnames.

Ben — I included a short SOC2 narrative extract in the package (section A.3) — please flag if you want anything else surfaced to the Clearwater reviewers.

Laura Bennett
Director, Service Operations | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.inference
